name: comp-167
title: Emoji Sentiment Picker
description: A one-row sentiment picker: five round radio buttons, each wrapping an emoji from angry to laughing, under the question How did it go? The chosen face takes a brighter ring.
use: Asking for a fast one-tap mood or satisfaction score right after a task or a chat.
avoid: No words name the faces on screen, so the scale rests on the emoji meaning the same to everyone.
a11y: The labels defined in the data are never rendered, so each face is named only by its emoji character; arrow keys and a visible focus ring still work. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white question sits left-aligned above five equal circles joined in one row on black. Each circle is a thin grey outline around a large emoji face, running from an angry frown to a wide grin.
behaves: Clicking a face selects it and lightens its ring; keyboard focus adds a second outer ring. The clip begins on Neutral and finishes on Sad.
customise: Faces come from an items array inside the file; change the emoji or the stored labels there. Circle size, gap and ring colour are utility classes in the same file.
weight: light: Five small circles with emoji glyphs and a short ring colour fade.
